rule_weakening: Law 5, no test is weakened to get green (audit 2026-11-25; review fixes 2026-11-25): a weakening a change adds (a skip, an xfail, a swallowed exit code, or a line of a file that decides what runs: conftest.py, the pytest section of pytest.ini/tox.ini/setup.cfg/pyproject.toml, scripts/test_fast.sh, tests/needs_env.txt; the kinds and the files are in scripts/weakening_declared.py) fails the light job unless declared here under weakening -> PATH: [{line_sha256, count, reason, pr, author, reviewer, reviewed_at, signature_note}]. line_sha256 is sha256(PATH + newline + the added line exactly as committed); the ::error of each undeclared line prints it and the count. A record covers ONE change, like rule_2026_11_15: only records absent at the merge base count, and their counts add up to exactly the net-new occurrences of that line (added minus deleted in the same file). Signed: a reason, an author, a reviewer whose identity is not the author's, and a signature_note when an agent writes a person's name (CLAUDE.md section 8). Law 6, no deleting evidence: a binary file a change deletes or rewrites is declared in allowed -> PATH with deleted_blob, the git blob id of the removed version (scripts/deletions_declared.py ANCHOR --blob PATH).
